name: INFINITY RPG
desc:
INFINITY RPG is a unique flip to Classic RPG games on Roblox. Conquer universal dimensions, battle fierce super bosses, find secret artifacts hidden in each world, and customize your build your way with saves, difficulties, and over 400+ swords, bows, guns, magic weapons, potions, and armor to choose from. Collect badges, advance through locations, complete enemy mastery, and keep track of it all in your compendium of beasts. Can you reach INFINITY?

🎧 Sound is HIGHLY recommended with its 100+ music tracks & hundreds of custom sound effects

🗜️ Max Level: 150.00M
🖱️ Auto-clicking is allowed.
🌱 Looking for the Classic experience? Enable it in your Settings and teleport from the Hub!
